name: How quickly can black spots or mold spread on walls?

mainEntity.name: How quickly can black spots or mold spread on walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black spots or mold can spread surprisingly quickly on walls, especially if moisture and suitable conditions are present. Under ideal circumstances (warmth, moisture, food source), mold can begin to grow within 24-48 hours and visibly expand within a few days. The rate of spread depends on factors like the type of mold, humidity levels, temperature, and the porosity of the affected material. Promptly addressing moisture issues is key to limiting its growth.
